limitations: A finite owned holder opens only the new synthetic settings file with read sharing and no write/delete sharing; an independent write open genuinely refuses while reads stay available.
An owned earlier choice in plain absolute form is replaced only after release by the actual picker with the verbatim canonical form, so preserved and replaced bytes are distinguishable.
The refused actual picker save reports saved false and keeps the exact prior bytes; status still verifies the choice because the prior file names the same package.
This does not cover truncation by process death or disk-full during an in-place write, other packages, or every filesystem race; B4/J1 partial and B5 inactive.
No personal settings, Vault/archive, account, credentials, task, server, Memory pin or Moriium source changes.
